## Health Score Rubric

Give the site a health score out of 100 based on the categories below, then take the weighted average.

### Console (weight: 15%)
- No errors → full marks
- A few errors → partial credit
- Lots of errors → low score

### Links (weight: 10%)
- No broken links → full marks
- Deduct for each broken link, more if it is an important link

### Per-Category Scoring (Visual, Functional, UX, Content, Performance, Accessibility)
Start at 100 and deduct points for each issue in proportion to how bad it is. Serious issues should cost a lot; minor polish issues should cost a little. Use a sensible floor.

Severity guide:
- **Serious:** anything that really hurts the experience.
- **Moderate:** noticeable problems.
- **Minor:** small stuff.

### Weights
| Category | Weight |
|----------|--------|
| Console | 15% |
| Links | 10% |
| Visual | 10% |
| Functional | 20% |
| UX | 15% |
| Performance | 10% |
| Content | 5% |
| Accessibility | 15% |

### Final Score
Weighted average of the category scores. Round sensibly.
